reviews.text: I asked for a Happy Meal and they gave me a Sad Meal. The toy was just a receipt. My daughter cried for forty minutes. I cried for forty-one.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: The ice cream machine wasn't working. I know, shocking. But the employee looked me dead in the eye and said 'it's a lifestyle choice.' Sir, it's dairy.
reviews.author: Jenny L.

reviews.text: Ordered a Big Mac. Received a medium sadness between two buns. The lettuce had given up on life. Five stars for honesty, one star because I can't give five.
